info.title: Gridio B2B API definition
info.description:
Definition of Gridio B2B REST API endpoints.

Current definition covers MVP of the portal (ie. provision of authentication and fleet overview functionality).

Note the follwing:
* when using start and end dates as query parameter, both dates are inclusive. So when you need data only for 12th of August 2024, set both
  start and end date values to 2024-08-12

get.summary:
Get list of all current devices in fleet with optional filtering. Ordered by last added devices
being on top of the list. Order descending. Legacy endpoint for new schema use V2.

parameters.name: business_id
parameters.description: Business ID for the customer request

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset for the query (start at n-th customer). If missing, assumed zero.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Pagination page size, required parameter

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
Fuzzy filter for a set of customers. Filter string is matched with customer id, external customer id
email or phone number. Must be at least 4 characters. Note that customer locations are not provided
within customer objects container in this respons. For customer's locations you need to request each
customer data separately with get customer by ID request.

grant_type.description: OAuth2 compliant grant type field. Current implementation only supports credentials flow, therefore this must be set to "password" for login request and "refresh_token" for token refresh request.

expires_in.description: Optional access token expiry time in seconds

policy.description: Smart charging policy for the device

solar_start_level.description: Solar production power from where onwards solar charging starts [W]

solar_smart_meter_aware.description: Indicator whether inverter installation includes smart meter.

fixed_location_id.description: Location ID for fixed devices (eg. solar, chargers)

external_customer_count.description:
In case there are customers belonging to other businesses connected to the same vehicle, then
this number will be greater than zero.

DeviceV2.description: Device object representing a connected energy device (vehicle, charger, battery, or solar inverter)

phys_id.description: Physical device identifier (e.g., VIN for vehicles)

setup_complete.description: Whether device setup has been completed

DeviceConnectorData.description: Device display and capability information from the connector

opt_out.description: Whether smart charging is currently opted out

opt_out_until.description: ISO timestamp or empty string when opt-out expires

charge_by.description: Daily target completion time in HH:MM format

charge_from.description: Daily charging start time in HH:MM format

guaranteed_soc.description: Minimum SoC percentage below which price constraints are ignored

devices_by_type.description: List of device counts by device type

savings.description: Daily savings of the fleet in EUR over the given time period

energy_cost.description: Energy cost incurred by the fleet in EUR over the given time period

smart_charged_wh.description: Smart charged Wh for the fleet at given day

max_capacity_w.description: Maximum total capacity (power) of the fleet in W over the given time period

max_solar_w.description: Maximum solar production capacity (power) of the fleet in W over the given time period

max_capacity_w.description: Maximum total capacity (power) of the fleet at given day in W

min_capacity_w.description: Minimum total capacity (power) of the fleet at given day in W

max_solar_w.description: Maximum solar production capacity (power) of the fleet at given day in W

charging_capacity_w.description: Average charging capacity of the fleet in W at given time period

solar_capacity_w.description: Average solar capacity of the fleet in W at given time period
